headline: Your expiry-day trading shows a clear pattern

expiry_day_trading.why_it_matters: The cost of the expiry-day pattern is ₹1,16,891, coming from 90 trades that together produced a loss of ₹1,16,891, an average loss of ₹1,299 per trade, a win rate of 29% and an average return loss of 28%. By comparison, the remaining 124 trades showed a loss of ₹449 on average, a win rate of 37% and an average return loss of 5%.
expiry_day_trading.rule: Set a hard cap on expiry-day trades before the open.

closing: Consider applying this rule in the coming month
